# h2o-dimer-opt

Water dimer geometry optimization at HF/6-31G*

Generated by `scripts/regenerate_doc_examples.py` from the canonical
input `input-h2o-dimer-opt.py`.

- `input-h2o-dimer-opt.py`: input script

- `stderr.txt`: full captured stderr from the queued run
- `artifact-status.json`: machine-readable run status
- `output-h2o-dimer-opt.bibtex`
- `output-h2o-dimer-opt.molden`
- `output-h2o-dimer-opt.out`
- `output-h2o-dimer-opt.population.json`
- `output-h2o-dimer-opt.population.txt`
- `output-h2o-dimer-opt.qvf`
- `output-h2o-dimer-opt.references`
- `output-h2o-dimer-opt.system`
- `output-h2o-dimer-opt.traj`
- `output-h2o-dimer-opt.xyz`
